name: VoxelPipe
definition: A highly flexible and efficient software pipeline for programmable triangle voxelization, written in CUDA. It supports fully conservative and thin voxelizations, multiple boolean, floating point, vector-typed render targets, user-defined vertex and fragment shaders, and a bucketing mode (A-buffer) generating the full list of fragments per voxel.
summary: VoxelPipe is a CUDA-based, programmable pipeline for converting triangle meshes into voxel grids, distinguished by its support for arbitrary render targets and tile-based load balancing.
